title: 第1章 一天涨一年功力第2章 死亡结算功力上涨
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 大魏宣和三十年，冬。
京城西北侧，天牢。
“杀了我吧！给我个痛快！这天牢的阴煞气钻进骨髓，老子一刻也受不了了！”
“老哥，听我一句劝，再熬两天。”
“老子生不如死，为何还要等！”
“因为后日便是冬至，按大魏律法，冬至那天咽气的囚犯，官府会出一两银子的安葬费。你要是今日死了，我就拿不到钱了.。”
“……我都要死了，还得替你省那点钱？！”
“那是自然，死者为大，您就当行行好，成全兄弟这一回？”
丁字号狱卒房内，一盏油灯豆大的火苗摇曳，
陈然站在一旁，有一搭没一搭的跟身旁的囚犯聊着天。
其实他并不是这个世界的人，只是在一次下班后与大运正面撞击后，转世投胎到了这具身体当中，直至十八岁才觉醒了前世宿慧。
这具身体也叫陈然，年方十八，家中世代为狱卒，妥妥的“狱二代”。
可惜这个“二代”含金量有点低。
半个月前，前身因在当值时打了个盹，被新晋的顶头上司王校尉抓住把柄。
被当做用来杀鸡儆猴牺牲品，一脚踢到了这丁字号死牢执晚班。
这里关押的虽不是什么绝世魔头，却都是些穷凶极恶的江湖草莽，煞气最重。
身体本就体弱，扛不住这日夜侵蚀的阴煞之气，昨夜一场风寒，近乎送了命。
若不是觉醒前世苏慧，恢复了气血，恐怕早就成为了一具尸体了。
“开局地狱难度啊……”
陈然吐槽了一句，喉咙发痒，剧烈咳嗽起来。
这身体太废了。
在这吃人的天牢，没有武功傍身，就是个死。
王校尉把他扔到这儿，摆明了是想让他死。
突然。
陈然瞳孔收缩。
一本古朴厚重的书籍，凭空悬浮在半空。
书封上刻着四个字——镇狱天书。
“金手指？”
陈然眼睛一亮，作为穿越者他自然不陌生。
天书一片空白，只有几行小字浮现。
【镇守天牢一日，奖励：一年功力】
【当前状态：未领取】
【是否领取？】
陈然盯着那行字，嘴角微微上扬。
一天一年？
这哪是坐牢，这是在刷经验啊！
没有犹豫。
“领取，必须领取！”
他在心中默念。
content_en:
In the 30th year of the reign of Emperor Xuanhe of the Wei Dynasty, winter.
On the northwest side of the capital, Tianlao.
"Kill me! Give me a good time! The evil spirit of Tianlao has penetrated into my bones, and I can't stand it for a moment!"
"Brother, listen to my advice and stay up for two more days."
"I would rather die than live, why do I have to wait!"
"Because the day after tomorrow is the winter solstice, according to the laws of the Wei Dynasty, the government will pay one tael of silver for the burial expenses of prisoners who die on the winter solstice. If you die today, I will not get the money."
"...I'm going to die, and I still have to save that little money for you?!"
"That's natural. The deceased is the greatest, so you should do good and fulfill your brother's needs this time?"
In the T-shaped jailer's room, a flame as big as an oil lamp flickered,
Chen Ran stood aside, chatting with the prisoner next to him.
In fact, he was not from this world, but after a head-on collision with the Universiade after get off work, he was reincarnated into this body. He did not awaken to the wisdom of his previous life until he was eighteen years old.
This body is also called Chen Ran, who is eighteen years old. His family has been a jailor for generations, and he is a proper "second generation prisoner".
It's a pity that the gold content of this "second generation" is a bit low.
Half a month ago, my predecessor took a nap while on duty and was caught by his newly promoted immediate superior, Captain Wang.
He was treated as a victim to scare the monkeys, and was kicked to death to work the night shift.
Although the people imprisoned here are not some peerless demons, they are all extremely vicious people with the most evil spirits.
My body was already weak and could not withstand the evil spirit that eroded day and night. A cold wind last night nearly cost me my life.
If he hadn't awakened Su Hui from his previous life and recovered his energy and blood, he might have become a corpse long ago.
"It's so difficult to start with hell..."
Chen Ran complained, his throat felt itchy, and he coughed violently.
This body is so useless.
In this cannibal prison, without martial arts, you will die.
Commander Wang threw him here, clearly wanting him to die.
Sudden.
Chen Ran's pupils contracted.
A simple and thick book was suspended in mid-air out of thin air.
There are four words engraved on the cover of the book - The Heavenly Book of Prison Suppression.
"Goldfinger?"
Chen Ran's eyes lit up. As a time traveler, he was naturally no stranger.
The Book of Heaven is blank, with only a few lines of small characters emerging.
[Guard the Tianlao for one day, reward: one year of skill]
[Current status: Not received]
【Do you want to receive it? 】
Chen Ran stared at the line of words, the corners of his mouth raised slightly.
One day and one year?
This is not going to jail, this is gaining experience!
No hesitation.
"Get it, you must get it!"
He thought silently in his mind.
title_en: Chapter 1: One day’s skill increases for one year Chapter 2: Death settlement skill increases
